name: [Provenex] UNVERIFIED chunk spike
message:
More than 50 UNVERIFIED chunks appeared in Provenex receipts over the last hour.

UNVERIFIED means a chunk reached the retrieval boundary whose fingerprint is not in the Provenex index. That usually signals one of:
  1. An ingest pipeline gap (a corpus was added to the vector store directly, bypassing Provenex ingestion).
  2. A poisoning attempt (an adversary injected chunks into the vector store).
  3. A genuine miss (legitimate data the operator has not yet ingested).

First response:
  1. Group the UNVERIFIED counts by `@policy.access_control.decisions.inputs.request_context.jurisdiction` to spot one-jurisdiction spikes.
  2. Pull a sample of the offending chunk fingerprints from the receipts' sources[].fingerprint -- the SHA-256 prefix is enough to correlate with the upstream ingestion log.
  3. Decide whether to ingest the missing corpus (case 1 or 3) or quarantine the agent (case 2).

Fires on >50 UNVERIFIED outcomes per hour. Tune the threshold for your baseline.
